tool_input.command: head -20 data/feature_history.csv; echo "---"; wc -l data/feature_history.csv
hops --help 2>&1 | head -60
hops fg --help 2>&1; echo "======SQL"; hops sql --help 2>&1
hops fg create --help 2>&1; echo "====INSERT"; hops fg insert --help 2>&1; echo "====DERIVE"; hops fg derive --help 2>&1

hops fg create feature_history_f2c3e4 --version 1 \
  --primary-key account_id \
  --event-time event_time \
  --features "account_id:string:Account id,event_time:bigint:Event time epoch ms,f1:double,f2:double,f3:double" \
  --description "Raw feature history revisions" --json 2>&1 | tail -30
hops fg insert feature_history_f2c3e4 --version 1 --file data/feature_history.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -30
hops trino --help 2>&1 | head -30; echo "====TABLES"; hops trino tables --help 2>&1 | head -20
hops sql "SELECT account_id, event_time, f1, f2, f3 FROM feature_history_f2c3e4_1 ORDER BY account_id, event_time LIMIT 5" --json 2>&1 | tail -40
tool_input.description: Test Trino query on history FG

tool_input.command: hops --no-verify sql "SELECT account_id, event_time, f1, f2, f3 FROM feature_history_f2c3e4_1 ORDER BY account_id, event_time LIMIT 5" --json 2>&1 | tail -40
hops --no-verify trino tables iceberg.mlpabab3b55 --json 2>&1 | grep -i f2c3e4
hops --no-verify trino tables iceberg.mlpabab3b55 --json 2>&1 | tail -40
hops --no-verify trino catalogs --json 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "===CTX"; hops context 2>&1 | grep -iE "project|schema|store" | head
hops --no-verify trino tables hudi.mlpabab3b55 --json 2>&1 | grep -i f2c3e4
hops --no-verify trino schemas hudi --json 2>&1 | tail -20

hops --no-verify trino tables hudi.mlpabab3b55_featurestore --json 2>&1 | grep -i f2c3e4; echo "---also iceberg fs---"; hops --no-verify trino tables iceberg.mlpabab3b55_featurestore --json 2>&1 | grep -i f2c3e4
tool_input.description: Find FG table in featurestore schema

tool_input.command:
hops --no-verify sql --schema mlpabab3b55_featurestore \
"SELECT account_id, event_time, f1, f2, f3 FROM feature_history_f2c3e4_1 ORDER BY account_id, event_time LIMIT 5" --json 2>&1 | tail -15

hops --no-verify sql --catalog hudi --schema mlpabab3b55_featurestore \
"SELECT account_id, event_time, f1, f2, f3 FROM feature_history_f2c3e4_1 ORDER BY account_id, event_time LIMIT 3" --json 2>&1 | tail -25
hops --no-verify fg preview feature_history_f2c3e4 --version 1 --n 3 --json 2>&1 | tail -25
tool_input.description: Preview FG to confirm data readable

tool_input.command: hops --no-verify trino catalogs --json 2>&1 | grep -i Catalog

for cat in delta hive; do echo "=== $cat ==="; hops --no-verify sql --catalog $cat --schema mlpabab3b55_featurestore \
"SELECT account_id, event_time, f1, f2, f3 FROM feature_history_f2c3e4_1 LIMIT 2" --json 2>&1 | grep -E "account_id|TrinoExternalError|TrinoUserError|Error" | head -3; done

hops --no-verify sql --catalog delta --schema mlpabab3b55_featurestore --limit 0 --json \
"WITH valid AS (
  SELECT account_id, f1, f2, f3,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS rn
  FROM feature_history_f2c3e4_1
  WHERE event_time <= 1773313200000
)
SELECT account_id,
       ROUND(1.0/(1.0+exp(-(1.7398*f1 + 0.3722*f2 + 0.7841*f3 + 0.588))), 6) AS score
FROM valid
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY account_id" 2>&1 | grep -E '"account_id"|"score"' | head -12
echo "--- count check ---"
hops --no-verify sql --catalog delta --schema mlpabab3b55_featurestore --json \
"SELECT count(DISTINCT account_id) AS n_total, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_time <= 1773313200000 THEN account_id END) AS n_atT FROM feature_history_f2c3e4_1" 2>&1 | grep -E '"n_total"|"n_atT"'
tool_input.description: Run scoring query and account counts

tool_input.command:
mkdir -p .tmp
hops --no-verify sql --catalog delta --schema mlpabab3b55_featurestore --limit 0 --json \
"WITH valid AS (
  SELECT account_id, f1, f2, f3,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS rn
  FROM feature_history_f2c3e4_1
  WHERE event_time <= 1773313200000
)
SELECT account_id,
       ROUND(1.0/(1.0+exp(-(1.7398*f1 + 0.3722*f2 + 0.7841*f3 + 0.588))), 6) AS score
FROM valid
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY account_id" 2>/dev/null > .tmp/scores.json
echo "rows in json:"; grep -c '"account_id"' .tmp/scores.json
echo "first chars:"; head -c 60 .tmp/scores.json; echo; echo "last chars:"; tail -c 40 .tmp/scores.json
tool_input.description: Capture clean scoring JSON to file

tool_input.command:
hops --no-verify fg create scoresf2c3e4 --version 1 \
  --primary-key account_id \
  --online \
  --features "account_id:string:Account id,score:double:Logistic score as of T" \
  --description "Batch scores as of T=1773313200000" --json 2>&1 | grep -E '"name"|"version"|"online|"id"|Error' | head
hops --no-verify fg insert scoresf2c3e4 --version 1 --file .tmp/scores.json --json 2>&1 | grep -E '"rows"|"feature_group"|Error|error' | head

echo "=== schema/online ==="; hops --no-verify fg info scoresf2c3e4 --version 1 --json 2>&1 | grep -E '"online_enabled"|"name"|"primary"|"type"' | head -20
echo "=== offline row count ==="; hops --no-verify sql --catalog delta --schema mlpabab3b55_featurestore --json \
"SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT account_id) AS d FROM scoresf2c3e4_1" 2>/dev/null | grep -E '"n"|"d"'
echo "=== preview ==="; hops --no-verify fg preview scoresf2c3e4 --version 1 --n 3 --json 2>&1 | grep -E '"account_id"|"score"'
tool_input.description: Verify final FG schema, count, online flag, preview
